notes: Per-record opt-in with live consent, author-signed publish, relay countersign, tombstone withdrawal, own-record export, relay-signed labels. Clients must sign; relay never holds author keys.
Envelope v1, 4 payload schemas, 32KB limit, deep privacy scan (keys, emails, coordinate pairs), regionCell<=5. Forwarding of third-party-origin records is not supported (origin must equal sender).
Ed25519 author sig, relay countersign bound to hash+authorSig, signed batches, dual-signed migration proofs; domain-separated contexts. Signatures prove assertion, not truth.
Per-peer outbox, 100-record batches, exponential backoff + injected jitter, dead letter after 8, requeue, status. Transport is a port (default always retry); real HTTP lives in the relay.
Persistent nonce store + ReplayGuard, duplicate registry, idempotent import, malicious-peer scenarios covered. Seen markers kept 30 days then purged by sweeper.
Total order (revision, tombstone, smaller hash) so arrival order never matters; author-key continuity incl. migration successors; rollback/fork/override/author conflicts logged.
Pending/trusted/suspended/blocked, pinned key with reset-on-rotate, per-minute record limit, daily byte quota, reputation counters, auto-suspend after 25 consecutive rejections.
Peer/domain(+subdomains)/author-key lists, signed export, import from trusted pinned peers into review queue only. Records from blocked sources rejected with reason.
Dual-signed statements, successor keys, redirect tombstones on old relay, learned by peers from them. Rotation statements for other relays enter only via operator submit; no destination-side import.
